title: Mali live: Army says armed 'terrorist' groups launch attacks on military positions nationwide
summary: Mali's ​army ​said on Saturday that unidentified armed "terrorist" groups ​had attacked ‌⁠military positions ‌in the ⁠capital and in several towns in the country's interior, with fighting ongoing. Journalists reported hearing gunfire at the country's international airport. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
